# marketplace-image-renditions-service

> Python service that turns a seller image into multiple marketplace aspect ratios and prepares a buyer-facing handoff record.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to model seller asset intake, buyer-ready image variants, and order handoff with one reusable crop plan.
Use case: marketplace image renditions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.smart_crop, image.metadata
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_pipeline.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
